title: Reduction in live loads.
officialText:
Except for uniform live loads at roofs, all other minimum uniformly distributed live loads, L , in
o
Table 1607.1 are permitted to be reduced in accordance with Section 1607.9.1 or 1607.9.2. Roof uniform live loads, other than
special purpose roofs of Section 1607.11.2.2, are permitted to be reduced in accordance with Section 1607.11.2. Roof uniform live
loads of special purpose roofs are permitted to be reduced in accordance with Section 1607.9.1 or 1607.9.2.
